name: 52641 · Mt Pleasant, IA
findings: ZIP 52641 (Mt Pleasant) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52641 (Mt Pleasant) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 52641 (Mt Pleasant) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
